question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either implementation, but pending deferral changes the operator and upgrade tradeoff between future recoverability and clear terminal failure state.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing blocker is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or the broader delivery ledger ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery design is settled.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing blocker is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or the broader delivery ledger ships.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged outbound recovery rewrite owns the closest current recovery semantics this tradeoff modifies.
